tool.name: create_agent
tool.title: Start a Paseo agent
tool.description: Create a workspace in a Paseo project and start a coding agent on it with an initial prompt. Use serverId and projectId exactly as listed by the Paseo projects catalog. state=completed means the agent received the prompt, not that its task is done. accepted, submitted, or waiting_for_host mean Paseo is still working on it: call request_status with this invocation's ID instead of calling create_agent again.

serverId.description: Host ID from the Paseo projects, workspaces, or agents catalog.

projectId.description: Project ID from the Paseo projects catalog, for the same serverId.

prompt.description: The message to send to the agent.

isolation.description: local runs in the project directory; worktree creates a new git worktree.

worktreeMode.description: Only with isolation=worktree. branch-off (default) makes a new branch; checkout-branch uses branch; checkout-pr uses prNumber.

baseRef.description: Only with worktreeMode=branch-off: ref to branch from. Defaults to the project's current upstream branch.

branch.description: Required with worktreeMode=checkout-branch: existing branch to check out.

prNumber.description: Required with worktreeMode=checkout-pr: pull request number, 1 or more.

forge.description: Only with worktreeMode=checkout-pr: forge ID such as github. Defaults to github.

worktreeSlug.description: Only with isolation=worktree: name for the worktree. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter or digit.

provider.description: Agent provider ID. Defaults to the provider last chosen in Paseo's New workspace form.

model.description: Model ID. Defaults to the provider's saved model, else the provider default.

modeId.description: Permission mode ID. Defaults to the provider's default mode; saved modes are never applied unattended.

thinkingOptionId.description: Thinking option ID for the model.

tool.name: send_prompt
tool.title: Send a prompt to a Paseo agent
tool.description: Send a message to an existing Paseo agent. Use serverId and agentId from the Paseo agents catalog. state=completed means the agent accepted the message and started its turn. accepted or waiting_for_host mean Paseo is still delivering it: call request_status with this invocation's ID instead of sending again.

serverId.description: Host ID from the Paseo projects, workspaces, or agents catalog.

agentId.description: Agent ID from the Paseo agents catalog, for the same serverId.

prompt.description: The message to send to the agent.

activeTurnBehavior.description: What to do if the agent is mid-turn: steer (default) adds the message to the running turn; interrupt stops it first.

tool.name: request_status
tool.title: Check a Paseo request
tool.description: Report the current state of an earlier create_agent or send_prompt call by its invocation ID. If that request is still pending, Paseo continues it under the same idempotency key; it never starts a second one.

invocationId.description: The invocation ID of the earlier create_agent or send_prompt call.
